Form No. 3
C. 25,000-1-34

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE File No. B. REGISTRY. No. D. 5785 Date 21 / 4 / 34）

REPORT
S.2, Special Branch
Date April 21, 1934

Subject (in full) Peter Silin, Soviet Employee.

Made by D.S. Tcheremshansky Forwarded by Em Golan H.

Peter Silin, 38, U.S.S.R. diplomatic courier, arrived
at Shanghai from Moscow via Kobe, Japan, on March 31, 1934 by
s.s. "Shanghai Maru" accompanied by another courier J.
Antashevitch. Silin holds a diplomatic passport No.2551
issued by the Commissariat for Foreign Affairs on August 2,
1933 in Moscow. Passport bears the Chinese visa issued by
the Chinese Embassy in Moscow on March 7, 1934.
Silin stated in the Alien Declaration Form that he
will stay at Shanghai for 15 days and will reside in the
U.S.S.R. Consulate-General.

（批：File entry sent to Ins. S.）

G Tcheremshansky
D. S.

Deputy Commissioner
Special Branch.
